crossRefs.note: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God…

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.
translations.bsb: So the lords of the Philistines brought her seven fresh bowstrings that had not been dried, and she tied him up with them.
translations.kjv: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound
translations.asv: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withes which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.
